<function name="OnValueChanged" parent="DColorPalette" type="panelhook">
	<description>Called when the color is changed after clicking a new value. For Override</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<file line="228-L230">lua/vgui/dcolorpalette.lua</file>
	<args>
		<arg name="newcol" type="Color">The new color of the <page>DColorPalette</page></arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Creates a DFrame with a color palette that prints values after being changed.</description>
	<code>
local frame = vgui.Create( "DFrame" )
frame:SetSize( ScrW() - 100, ScrH() - 100 )
frame:Center()
frame:MakePopup()

local palette = vgui.Create( "DColorPalette", frame )
palette:Dock( FILL )

function palette:OnValueChanged( newcol )
	PrintTable( newcol )
end
	</code>
	<output>The color chosen on the palette.</output>

</example>
